versions.content: Use of external service processor to read snapshot records If a DcmDsdService for service 0x19 with a DcmDsdSubService for subfunction 0x04 or 0x18 is configured and DcmDsdSubServiceFnc is configured for that service, 123 of 689 Document ID 18: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticCommunicationManager Specification of Diagnostic Communication Manager AUTOSAR CP R22-11 the Dcm shall leave the processing of the diagnostic request to the external service processor provided in DcmDsdSubServiceFnc .
